correctness.rationale: The exact graph has strongly regular parameters (27,16,10,8) and adjacency minimum eigenvalue -2. The spectral cut bound and explicit nine-coclique partition prove C(k)=2 floor(k(27-k)/3) for all 0<=k<=27. The ground-state Hamiltonian is 216-2 C(k)-t(27-2k), giving the four transition fields and five affine energy pieces. All 134217728 spin configurations were enumerated twice with independent integer recurrences, and both programs returned the same N_k counts. The complete source code was replayed from the package; finite enumeration is exhaustive, not sample-based.

value.rationale: Critical-field residual entropy is a natural measurable/model-theoretic observable in frustrated statistical mechanics. The exact count of each field-selected ground-state sector and of each multiple-magnetization transition manifold distinguishes degeneracy from spectral cutoff data. The Schläfli graph is a natural unique highly symmetric strongly regular system, not an arbitrarily parameterized slice.
